description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectActivityReport class within the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends ProjectReport to generate reports related to project activities, including preparing filter parameters, validation rules, report headers, and data retrieval methods. The class interacts with other system components via various imports and relies on traits for additional functionality.

classes.name: ProjectActivityReport
classes.description: A report class for generating project activity reports within the OrangeHRM system. It prepares filter parameters from request data, defines validation rules, specifies report headers, and retrieves report data using specific filter parameters. It extends the ProjectReport base class and uses the I18NHelperTrait for localization support.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Initializes and populates filter parameters from the request endpoint, including project ID, activity ID, date range, and timesheet inclusion flag. Sets sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for request parameters, ensuring the activity ID is a positive entity ID that exists.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the report header configuration, including columns for employee name and time in hours, with localized column titles.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on provided filter parameters, returning a ProjectActivityDetailedReportData instance.
